name: Oscar's Mexican Food
notes: Work-list website (rigobertostacoshop.com) is a wrong-business trap: it resolves to Rigoberto's Taco Shop, an unrelated Oregon chain (Milwaukie/Woodburn, OR), not this Poway restaurant. The restaurant's actual first-party domain oscarsmexicanfoodca.com is only an app-download splash page with no menu. Sourced instead from fromtherestaurant.com's page for this exact restaurant name/address (12711 Poway Rd), which is the restaurant's own ordering platform (not a marketplace) - prices are POS-style with varied odd cents and no uniform divisor, passing the markup test. Cross-checked against allmenus.com, which carries the same dish lineup but at roughly half the price - judged stale/outdated rather than markup (consistent direction, too large a gap for a delivery multiplier), so allmenus prices were not used, only its dish-name agreement.

notes: No website listed. Work-list restaurant is 'La Perla Cocina Mexicana #2' at 1880 Grand Ave, Pacific Beach - part of a small local chain with other unrelated-priced branches (Convoy St, Rosecrans St DoorDash listings are DIFFERENT branches, verified and rejected via embedded address JSON-LD). The Uber Eats listing for this exact address has been 'Closed on Uber Eats as of Jan 4, 2021' and lists dish names with no prices at all. No Toast/Square/Clover ordering platform found for this specific branch. Sourced instead from a customer-uploaded photograph of the restaurant's own in-store menu board on this restaurant's Google Maps listing (Menu tab) - address on the listing matches exactly. A second, visibly older photo of the same physical board on the same listing shows lower prices on every overlapping item (e.g. Eggs Rancheros $10.85 vs $11.85, Omelette $11.60 vs $12.75, 12 Rolled Tacos $16.35 vs $17.00) - consistent with ordinary price increases over time, which is why the newer/higher-priced board was used. Neither photo carries an explicit date stamp reachable from this session. The board's far right edge (Soups category, second half of Side Orders, A La Carte and Drinks prices) is cut off in the photograph and could not be read; those items are omitted rather than guessed.
